title: 翻译部分概览
goal: 了解翻译任务的材料和时间，并区分两个总体评分档的表现。

points.label: 说出翻译任务的材料与时间要求
区分两个评分档的意义与语言表现

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 原文长度与翻译总体评分

rows.v: 将 1 段中文译成英文。

cards.title: 总体评分档
cards.src: c2 大纲 第 4.2 节

items.stem: What is the direction of the translation task?
items.why: 任务是将中文段落译成英文，即第二项。

items.stem: How long is the source passage?
items.why: 原文长度为 180—200 个汉字，即第三项。

items.stem: What are the task time and its share of the paper?
items.why: 翻译任务为 30 分钟，占全卷 15%，即第一项。

items.stem: How does a translation in the 13–15 band convey meaning?
options: It barely conveys meaning but reads fluently.
It conveys meaning accurately but lacks coherence.
It barely conveys meaning and has substantial errors.
It conveys meaning accurately and reads fluently.
items.why: 13—15 分的译文准确传达原意，且译文通顺，即第四项。

items.stem: How does a translation in the 7–9 band convey meaning?
options: It conveys meaning accurately and fluently.
It only just conveys the original meaning.
It conveys meaning accurately without errors.
It conveys meaning accurately but fluency varies.
items.why: 7—9 分的译文勉强传达原意，即第二项。

items.stem: What language features characterize the 7–9 band?
options: Fluent expression with very few errors
items.why: 7—9 分的译文连贯性较弱，错误较多，即第三项。
